faq.a: Aaraf is associated with the Arabic form أعراف, whose core sense is heights, elevated places, summits.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aaraf?
faq.a: Aaraf is associated with Arabic. أعراف is the plural of عُرْف ('elevated place, crest') and is the title of sūra 7. Its use as a personal name is reported but not verified.
Yes — the underlying form أعراف is Arabic.
Aaraf can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
